intro.en: The dashboard is the first screen you see in CropWatch. It shows the locations and sensors you have access to, with the latest reading from each.

content.text: Sensors are grouped by location, such as a greenhouse or a field. Open a location to see the sensors in it.

alt.en: Screenshot of the CropWatch dashboard with sensors grouped by location

content.text: Each sensor shows whether it is reporting. A sensor that has stopped sending readings is marked as offline.
Open a sensor to see its readings as a chart, and choose the date range you want to look at.
